policy.capture: Values read from existing files; no evaluation or inference performed.
policy.publication: Captured values are immutable; private source provenance is maintained separately.
policy.recorded_cost: Historical timings and inference costs are evidence, not reproducible wall-time assertions.
policy.recorded_execution: Live cache-hit/miss and execution counters are preserved as historical evidence; replay independently requires zero misses and errors.
policy.recorded_table_build: Table rebuild is optional; preserve aggregate counts and check their internal conservation in quick mode.
policy.rounding: Preserve each source precision, notably MINE overall_accuracy rounded to 4 decimal places.
